meta.title: Streamnest Media Tools – Video and Image Utilities
meta.description: Convert and compress video locally, or remove image backgrounds with Streamnest media tools.

hero.heading: Work with media
hero.intro: Convert and compress video on your device, or create a clean transparent image with AI background removal.

tools.title: Video Converter
tools.description: Convert a local video to MP4, WebM, or MP3 with a browser-based media engine.

tools.title: Video Compressor
tools.description: Choose a practical 480p, 720p, or 1080p quality preset and reduce a local file.

tools.title: Video Trimmer
tools.description: Choose a start and end time, then create a shorter MP4 locally.

tools.title: Video Merger
tools.description: Join compatible clips from the same camera or device without uploading them.

tools.title: Audio Extractor
tools.description: Extract MP3 or WAV audio from a local video in your browser.

tools.title: Video to GIF
tools.description: Turn a short section of a video into a shareable animated GIF.

tools.title: Image Converter
tools.description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images locally with no upload.

tools.title: Image Compressor
tools.description: Create a smaller WebP image and choose the output quality.

tools.title: Image Resizer
tools.description: Resize a local image to a practical maximum width while keeping its proportions.

tools.title: Background Remover
tools.description: Use one AI credit to create a transparent PNG from a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.

home.privacyBody: Video conversion and compression stay in your browser. Background removal securely uploads only the image you choose for temporary processing.

meta.title: Free Local Video Converter – Convert Video in Your Browser
meta.description: Convert a local video to MP4, WebM, or MP3 in your browser without uploading the file to a server.

hero.heading: Convert video formats
hero.intro: Choose a video from your computer and convert it in this browser. The file stays on your device throughout processing.

notes: Processing stops if this tab closes
Large, batch, or 4K workflows are better suited to the future desktop app

meta.title: Free Local Video Compressor – Compress Video in Your Browser
meta.description: Reduce a local video file in your browser with practical quality presets and no server upload.

hero.heading: Make video files
hero.intro: Choose a practical size and quality balance, then compress the video directly on this device without sending it to a server.

notes: Small: compact 480p output for quick sharing
Balanced: practical 720p output for everyday use
The result depends on the source codec, motion, duration, and original bitrate

meta.title: AI Background Remover – Create a Transparent PNG
meta.description: Remove a JPG, PNG, or WebP image background and download a transparent PNG with Streamnest.

hero.heading: Remove an image
hero.intro: Upload one image, create a transparent result, and choose a simple preview background before downloading.

notes: Google sign-in protects the processing endpoint
Processed files use temporary private storage and result links

meta.title: Free Local Video Trimmer – Trim Video in Your Browser
meta.description: Trim a local video to a selected time range in your browser without uploading it.

hero.heading: Trim a video
hero.intro: Choose the start and end time, then create a shorter MP4 directly on this device.

notes: Choose start and end times in seconds
The selected video is never uploaded

meta.title: Free Local Video Merger – Join Compatible Clips
meta.description: Merge compatible local video clips in your browser without uploading them to a server.

hero.heading: Merge compatible clips
hero.intro: Select clips captured with compatible settings and join them into one MP4 in this browser.

video-merger.notesHeading: Use clips with matching media settings
notes: Use clips from the same camera or device
The selected clips are never uploaded

meta.title: Free Audio Extractor – Extract MP3 or WAV Locally
meta.description: Extract MP3 or WAV audio from a local video in your browser without uploading it.

hero.heading: Extract audio
hero.intro: Create an MP3 for everyday listening or a WAV file for editing, entirely on this device.

meta.title: Free Video to GIF Converter – Create GIFs Locally
meta.description: Turn a short video section into an animated GIF in your browser without uploading the source.

hero.heading: Turn a video clip
hero.intro: Choose a short section and practical output width, then create an animated GIF on this device.

video-to-gif.notesHeading: GIFs work best for small moments

meta.title: Free Local Image Converter – JPG, PNG and WebP
meta.description: Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images locally in your browser without uploading them.

hero.heading: Convert image formats
hero.intro: Choose an image and create a PNG, JPG, or WebP result directly in this browser.

notes: The image stays on this device

meta.title: Free Local Image Compressor – Make Images Smaller
meta.description: Compress a JPG, PNG, or WebP image into a smaller WebP result locally in your browser.

hero.heading: Make image files
hero.intro: Choose the output quality and create a compact WebP without sending the image to a server.

meta.title: Free Local Image Resizer – Resize Images in Your Browser
meta.description: Resize a JPG, PNG, or WebP image to a practical width locally without uploading it.

hero.heading: Resize an image
hero.intro: Choose a maximum width and create a resized WebP directly on this device.

notes: The tool never enlarges the source
